Class TimerDisplay

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.TimerDisplay
public class TimerDisplay extends Object
The TimerDisplay class is responsible for managing a countdown timer with a specified duration and notifying a UI component when the timer expires

  • Method Details

    • start

      public void start(int durationSeconds)
      Starts the countdown timer with the specified duration in seconds and updates the associated UI component. Once the timer expires, it notifies the UI and increments the expiration count.
      Parameters:
      durationSeconds - the duration of the countdown timer in seconds

    • stop

      public void stop()
      Stops the currently running countdown timer if it exists and is active. This method interrupts the timer thread to cease its execution prematurely.
